name: Rorec White Rice Skin Beauty Essence 15ml
description:
Rorec White Rice Skin Beauty Essence – 15ml
Product of China

Transform your skincare routine with Rorec White Rice Skin Beauty Essence. This lightweight essence is designed to enhance your natural beauty while nourishing and protecting your skin.

Key Benefits:

Brightens and evens skin tone for a fairer, glowing complexion.

Reduces acne, blemishes, and dark spots.

Minimizes the appearance of pores and smoothens skin texture.

Deeply moisturizes dry skin, keeping it soft and supple.

Firms and keeps skin taut throughout the day.

Protects against sun damage and skin inflammation.

Weight: 15ml
